title: Shakthi
desc: Sakthi dreams of becoming a superhero. His wish unexpectedly comes true when the girl he is helping secure college admission dies due to unforeseen circumstances.

title: Rekhachithram
desc: A disgraced cop returns to active duty and attempts to regain his honour by investigating a murder that happened 40 years ago.

title: Bulbul
desc: A gangster's daughter attempts suicide after Vijay spurns her. When threatened, Vijay falsely claims to love his childhood friend, unwittingly inviting further complications.

desc: Adi's life takes an unexpected turn after adopting Nidhi. However, their newfound contentment is quickly jeopardized by a series of disturbing events.

desc: Narasimha, a fiery but kind-hearted mechanic, becomes the guardian of an innocent family. Subsequently, he ends up taking on the ruthless kingpin Kariappan and his violent gang to protect them.

desc: A corrupt landlord is involved in gold smuggling, while the police try to apprehend the culprit. However, he is unaware that a person close to him plans to expose his illegal activities.
